selection_basis: Metadata only: city_id 001 Beijing; all stations; first 28 days of the documented archive start month. No data-value or algorithm-outcome selection.
time_zone: Timestamp strings are retained verbatim; archive README does not state timezone.

station_holdout.rest: train; validation is chronological within training stations

duplicate_policy: Per station-time-pollutant, one unique finite numeric value is retained; repeated copies collapse; two or more different numeric values invalidate that cell and set conflict flag. NULL plus one numeric value preserves the numeric value.
missing_policy: NULL, empty, nonnumeric and nonfinite cells remain missing. Never impute reference targets. Entire missing station-hours remain in the grid.
outlier_policy: Do not select or remove observations by numeric size; flag negative values and report diagnostics. No algorithm evaluation occurs in this dataset preparation.
observational_unit: station x time x pollutant; each is a distinct physical target, not a worker report
future_crowdsensing_interface: Simulated source identities, errors, participation and attacks must be declared separately and generated only where observed reference targets exist. Original station values remain hidden from estimators except explicitly budgeted training/reference labels.
license: Official public research download; README requests three citations. No explicit standard open license found in README or inspected official source text. Do not label CC BY.
